property_summary: SetMinSum(val) reverts exactly when the contract was already initialized, and on success MinSum becomes exactly val; since initialization cannot be undone, testing this requires an uninitialized contract, so the rule reduces to: on an uninitialized contract, SetMinSum(val) succeeds and MinSum becomes val.

confirmed_difference.thread_focus: whether a call `SetMinSum(args)` reverts or completes, and on which inputs
